globalAttributes.name: data-variant
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, a[role=button], input[type=submit|button|reset]. Button style. Leave it out for the default solid main button (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Combine with data-tone for color.

values.name: secondary
values.description: Tinted fill, no border. Second most important action.

values.name: ghost
values.description: Transparent, fill on hover. Toolbars, icon buttons, Cancel.

values.name: link
values.description: Looks like a link, keeps button semantics.

globalAttributes.name: data-tone
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, [data-badge], [data-callout], progress, any text element. Color role. Independent of data-variant. On text it sets the text color. For a custom color use style="--ts-tone: <color>" instead.

values.name: neutral
values.description: Grey. Default for secondary/outline/ghost buttons and badges.

globalAttributes.name: data-size
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, input, select. Control size relative to the current density.

globalAttributes.name: data-icon
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: button, a[role=button]. Square icon-only button. Must have an aria-label. Usually combined with data-variant="ghost".

globalAttributes.name: data-layout
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any container. Lays out the element's children. Wins over the element's own display, so it also works on label, article, fieldset, dialog. Space between children comes from data-gap, space around them from data-pad; children never get margins.

values.name: row
values.description: Horizontal row that wraps, items vertically centered.

values.name: grid
values.description: Responsive columns, each at least --ts-min wide (default 16rem).

values.name: split
values.description: Sidebar + content. First child is the sidebar (--ts-split, default 16rem); wraps on narrow screens.

values.name: center
values.description: Horizontally centered column with max width --ts-measure (default 72rem) and side padding.

globalAttributes.name: data-gap
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Space between the children of a data-layout element. Default md. Together with data-pad, the only spacing controls in tinystyle.

globalAttributes.name: data-pad
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any container: page wrappers, sections, panels, rows. Padding inside the element, on all sides. Use it instead of padding in style attributes. On data-layout="center" the side padding never drops below md. Overrides a component's own padding (e.g. data-pad="sm" on an article).

globalAttributes.name: data-align
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Cross-axis alignment of children (align-items).

globalAttributes.name: data-justify
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout]. Main-axis distribution of children (justify-content).

globalAttributes.name: data-wrap
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: [data-layout=row]. Whether a row wraps onto more lines. Rows wrap by default.

values.name: none
values.description: Keep everything on one line (nav items, icon + label).

globalAttributes.name: data-grow
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: a child of data-layout=row or stack. This child takes the remaining space (e.g. the search field in a toolbar, the input in an input + button row).

globalAttributes.name: data-density
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: html or any subtree. Control height and padding for everything inside.

values.name: compact
values.description: 2rem controls, smaller text. For dense apps.

globalAttributes.name: data-theme
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: html or any subtree. Forces light or dark mode. Leave it out to follow the operating system.

globalAttributes.name: data-badge
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: span. Small status label (counts, tags, states). Color with data-tone or style="--ts-tone: …".

globalAttributes.name: data-callout
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: div, [role=alert], [role=status]. Tinted message box. Put the title in <strong>. Color with data-tone (default info).

globalAttributes.name: data-muted
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any text element. Secondary text color.

globalAttributes.name: data-truncate
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any element. Single line, cut off with an ellipsis.

globalAttributes.name: data-sr-only
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any element. Hidden visually, still read by screen readers.

globalAttributes.name: data-pairs
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: dl. Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid.

globalAttributes.name: data-caption
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: any text element. Small, semibold, muted label text: captions above values, group headings like a letter in an index.

globalAttributes.name: data-avatar
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: span, div. Round avatar with initials, or an child that fills it. Colored by tone (default accent); size with data-size or style="--ts-avatar-size: 4rem".

globalAttributes.name: data-stretch
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle. On: the main link or button inside an article. Makes the whole card clickable through this element. Other links and buttons in the card stay clickable. Use it on the card's title link, or on a data-variant="link" button.

globalAttributes.name: data-shell
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: body or the outermost app wrapper. App shell: a navigation rail ([data-rail]) next to <main>. On narrow screens (< 48rem) the rail becomes a drawer.

globalAttributes.name: data-rail
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: nav inside [data-shell]. Navigation rail. Children: optional <header> (brand, collapse button), links/buttons or a <ul> of them, optional <footer> pinned to the bottom. Items need no attributes; mark the active one with aria-current="page". Put item text in a <span> so it can hide when collapsed.

globalAttributes.name: data-collapsed
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: [data-rail]. Icon-only rail. Text spans and [data-rail-label] elements are hidden. Toggle it from script.

globalAttributes.name: data-open
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: [data-rail]. On narrow screens, slides the rail in as a drawer and shows the [data-backdrop] that follows it. Toggle it from script.

globalAttributes.name: data-rail-label
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: any element inside [data-rail]. Hidden while the rail is collapsed (e.g. the user name in the rail footer).

globalAttributes.name: data-backdrop
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: an empty div right after the [data-rail]. Dims the page behind the open mobile drawer. Close the drawer when it is clicked.

globalAttributes.name: data-fab
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: button. Floating action button fixed in the bottom-right corner. Combine with data-icon and an aria-label.

globalAttributes.name: data-show
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (app.css). On: any element. Shows the element only on narrow (< 48rem) or wide screens.

values.name: narrow
values.description: Only below 48rem (e.g. the button that opens the drawer).

globalAttributes.name: data-menu
globalAttributes.description: tinystyle (menu.css). On: [popover] (dropdown) or any container (static menu). Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; <hr> separates groups. On a [popover] opened via popovertarget it is placed under its button.
